# Six-month review of home visits

Review of the first six months of the [[Hearthside Visits|homebound service]], September 2025 through February 2026.

## Numbers

85 patrons, 31 active volunteers, and 2,900 items loaned. The return rate is 98 percent, higher than at the branches.

## What patrons said

Most valued the conversation as much as the books. The common complaint was bags that missed their taste, which led to the preference cards described in [[Outreach volunteers check-in, 2026-02-05#Choosing titles]].

## Problems

Volunteer turnover is the main risk: nine volunteers left, mostly because of schedule changes. Winter weather delayed visits twice.
